scope: 本地 file:// 协议双击零服务器启动与经典脚本/模块加载策略兼容性验证
content: You need to pay attention to local testing — if you try to load the HTML file locally (i.e., with a file:// URL), you'll run into CORS errors due to JavaScript module security requirements. You need to do your testing through a server. Also, note that you might get different behavior from sections of script defined inside modules as opposed to in classic scripts.
conclusion: 在 file:// 协议本地双击打开时，ES 模块由于跨域安全要求会报 CORS 错误；纯原生经典脚本或自包含脚本可无障碍在本地双击零服务运行，确保双启动模式兼容。
